description: This Java class 'OutputContentFile' extends 'StaticContentFile' and implements 'Serializable'. It serves as a data carrier for static content data retrieved from an Infinispan cache, providing getter and setter methods for a ByteArrayOutputStream representing the file data.

classes.name: OutputContentFile
classes.description: A data class that extends StaticContentFile and implements Serializable, used for transferring static content data from cache to service layer.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the ByteArrayOutputStream representing the content file.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Sets the ByteArrayOutputStream representing the content file.
